About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is building a new AI business, and you’ll be one of its first technical sellers. Your job is to turn technically complex AI products into closed revenue.
You’ll sell a growing portfolio spanning AI-powered applications and agents for finance teams, as well as infrastructure that helps companies deploy and manage AI with greater control, security, and cost efficiency. This is a product-focused, quota-carrying technical sales role. You’ll help customers evaluate and purchase Ramp’s AI products, translating complex capabilities into clear business value and guiding opportunities from discovery through close.
This is a high-velocity commercial role, not a traditional pre-sales position where success ends with a great demo. You’ll be accountable for turning technical evaluations into commercial wins from start to finish. You’ll lead discovery, shape deal strategy, build executive-level business cases, deliver tailored demonstrations, navigate technical and commercial objections, and create urgency around a clear path to purchase.
You’ll move comfortably between technical and executive conversations. In one meeting, you may discuss model routing, APIs, integrations, data governance, and security with Engineering and IT teams. In the next, you may help Finance and executive leaders understand the ROI, total cost of ownership, and operational impact of adopting Ramp’s AI products.
You’ll join at a formative moment for Ramp’s AI business. As one of the first dedicated sellers for these products, you’ll help identify the strongest use cases, refine how we position and sell the portfolio, influence the customer experience, and build the playbook the broader team will eventually scale.

You’ll own the full customer lifecycle from discovery and evaluation through close, implementation, and adoption, helping customers translate their purchase into a successful deployment. This role combines Ramp’s resources and customer reach with the ownership, speed, and ambiguity of an early-stage team.

Carry a revenue quota and own the progression of AI product opportunities from initial discovery through purchase, ensuring business value is clear, technical requirements are validated, and obstacles to a decision are resolved.
Lead discovery with business and technical buyers to understand their goals, workflows, challenges, decision criteria, existing systems, and AI strategy.
Translate Ramp’s AI applications and infrastructure into compelling solution narratives tied to measurable business outcomes.
Build ROI and total cost of ownership analyses that quantify the value of Ramp’s AI products and create executive-level justification for investment.
Help customers identify high-value use cases, set realistic expectations, and establish a credible path from evaluation to production.

Apply strong commercial judgment to qualify opportunities, create urgency, address objections, identify risk, and keep customers moving toward a decision.
Lead customers through implementation after purchase, including deployment planning, stakeholder alignment, workflow design, technical coordination, enablement, and adoption.
Partner with Account Executives and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Security, Marketing, and post-sales teams to remove deployment blockers and deliver a strong customer experience from evaluation through production.
Bring structured customer and market feedback to internal teams to improve the products, positioning, sales execution, and customer experience.
Turn early customer conversations into repeatable messaging, demonstrations, qualification criteria, value stories, and sales plays as we build this go-to-market motion from the ground up.

5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, technical sales, Solutions Architecture, enterprise software sales, or a related customer-facing role.
Direct quota-carrying or deal-closing ownership of the pre-sale cycle—not only experience delivering demonstrations or supporting post-sale implementation.
A track record of independently influencing and winning complex B2B sales opportunities with clear revenue accountability.
Strong discovery and value-selling skills, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

Role Description
As a Solutions Consultant specializing in Security and Data Protection, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North America and Latin America customers evaluating Dropbox as part of their broader security, data protection, and governance strategy. Fluency in Portuguese is required for this role , as you will work directly with Portuguese-speaking customers and stakeholders across the region.
You will partner closely with Account Executives and customers to uncover security and business requirements, design solutions, demonstrate technical capabilities, and validate how Dropbox can help organizations discover, protect, govern, and securely collaborate on sensitive content.
The ideal candidate combines strong presales and customer-facing skills with deep expertise in modern data security. You should be comfortable engaging security practitioners, IT leaders, architects, and executives on topics including Data Access Governance (DAG), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data classification, Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) technologies, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Zero Trust.
You do not need prior experience with Dropbox's security products. We are looking for someone who understands the underlying security problems deeply and can quickly apply that expertise to Dropbox's platform and customers.

Partner with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle as the technical and security subject matter expert.
Lead technical discovery to understand customers' security architecture, sensitive data landscape, access models, security operations, compliance requirements, and business objectives.
Help customers identify and understand risks associated with sensitive content, excessive access, external sharing, inappropriate permissions, and data loss.
Translate customer security requirements into solution architectures, controls, workflows, demonstrations, and technical validation plans.
Demonstrate Dropbox security and data-protection capabilities through customer specific use cases rather than feature led presentations.
Design and execute proofs of concept and technical evaluations with clear success criteria and measurable outcomes.
Advise customers on how Dropbox fits within their broader security ecosystem, including identity, DLP, CASB/SSE, SIEM/SOAR, and data-security platforms.
Engage with Security, IT, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders and communicate effectively from practitioner through executive levels.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and other technical specialists to represent customer requirements and field feedback.

Minimum of 4 years in a customer-facing technical experience: Experience in a customer-facing role such as Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Security Architecture, Security Consulting, or a similar position, including technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation with enterprise customers.
Enterprise and SaaS security expertise: Strong knowledge of enterprise security architecture and modern approaches to protecting sensitive data across SaaS and cloud environments.
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and classification: Deep understanding of DLP, data classification, and sensitive-data discovery, including identifying sensitive content, policy creation, detection, alerting, investigation, and remediation.
Data Access Governance (DAG) and DSPM: Strong understanding of Data Access Governance and Data Security Posture Management, including effective permissions, excessive access, external sharing, public exposure, sensitive-data exposure, risk prioritization, least privilege, and remediation.
CASB and the broader security ecosystem: Strong understanding of CASB technologies and how SaaS applications integrate into an enterprise security architecture, including DLP, SSE/SASE, SIEM/SOAR, and other data-security controls.
Identity, access, and Zero Trust: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and the relationship between identity, permissions, sharing, and data exposure.
Technical solution selling and communication: Ability to translate complex security risks and customer requirements into architectures, controls, demonstrations, and proof-of-value criteria, while communicating credibly with security practitioners and connecting technical capabilities to business outcomes for executive stakeholders.
Fluency in Portuguese and English
Ability to travel domestically and internationally, no more than 20%

Data security platform experience: Hands-on or presales experience with DSPM, DAG, data governance, or data classification platforms such as Varonis, Cyera, BigID, Microsoft Purview , or similar technologies.
CASB/SSE/DLP platform experience: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP , or similar technologies.
Identity and access management experience: Experience with identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity and applying identity, permissions, groups, and least-privilege principles to SaaS applications.
Security ecosystem and integration experience: Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, and security integrations , with an understanding of how SaaS and data-security solutions fit into a customer's broader security architecture.
Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying security, privacy, or regulatory frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to enterprise customer requirements.
Relevant industry certifications are valued but are not required. Examples include: CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA, relevant Microsoft Security certifications, relevant certifications from Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Okta, or other enterprise security vendors

s.t:

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce.

Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.
Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.
What's the opportunity?
Fin is looking for an exceptional Senior Solutions Engineer to join our vibrant Customer Solutions Team. In this role, you’ll engage directly with our customers as their trusted advisor, playing a pivotal part in defining and demonstrating value across the entire sales cycle.

With a natural curiosity, independent thinking, and strong problem-solving skills, you’ll partner closely with Product, R&D, and Engineering to ensure our customers’ needs and insights are at the core of our AI powered solutions.

Build trust with customers by approaching challenges with empathy and curiosity
Continuously improve processes and contribute to building a best-in-class Solutions Engineering playbook at Fin
Commit to customer success, ensuring lasting value and proactively addressing challenges

Strong technical acumen with experience in conducting technical discovery and delivering high-impact value presentations.
Ability to solve problems independently while thriving in collaborative team environments
Proven time management skills in a dynamic team environment
Demonstrated ability to quickly identify and communicate the value proposition throughout the sales cycle.
Leverage your skills in translating complex business challenges into tailored Fin solutions, effectively communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and impact.
Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback and influence product direction.
Familiarity with managing POCs, RFPs, and addressing complex security questions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a passion for leading with empathy and curiosity
Ability to challenge the status quo and continuously improve Solutions Engineering processes and playbooks

Willing and able to travel occasionally

At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Policies
Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.
We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications.

We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values .
Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

## Ihre Aktivitäten ##
* Technische Beratung und Betreuung von Kunden bei anspruchsvollen Anwendungen in der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik
* Analyse von Kundenanforderungen sowie Ausarbeitung passender technischer Lösungsansätze
* Erstellung, Kalkulation und aktive Nachverfolgung von Angeboten
* Selbstständige Bearbeitung und Klärung technischer Kundenanfragen
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, den internationalen Werken sowie der Auftragsabwicklung
* Koordination, Begleitung und Unterstützung bei technischen Fragestellungen während der Auftragsphase
* Pflege und Dokumentation von Kunden- und Projektdaten im CRM-System

## Ihr Profil ##
* Technische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF, FH oder vergleichbarer Qualifikation
* Erfahrung in der industriellen Messtechnik, Elektro-/Automatisierungstechnik, Verfahrenstechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Umfeld
* Freude an der Kundenberatung und am Erarbeiten technischer Lösungen
* Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Kunden
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
* Französischkenntnisse sind von grossem Vorteil
